headlines.description: Bristol City stopped the rot at home by claiming a welcome point in a 1-1 draw with Wrexham.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wrexham extend unbeaten run with draw at Bristol City

headlines.description: Aston Villa's hopes of earning automatic Champions League qualification took a blow after they were beaten 1-0 at Galatasaray on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Villa succumb to late Galatasaray goal to suffer 2nd straight UCL loss

headlines.description: Arsenal dropped points from a winning position for the second time in as many games following a 1-1 draw with Borussia Dortmund at the Emirates Stadium on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal let lead slip again in UCL draw with Borussia Dortmund

headlines.description: Rayan Cherki scored a fine late equalizer as Manchester City snatched a 2-2 draw against Napoli in the Champions League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cherki magic denies Napoli win but Man City's struggles continue

headlines.description: A long-range stunner from Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé's double powered Real Madrid past PSV Eindhoven 5-1 for their fifth straight Champions League victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bellingham sparks five-goal second-half blitz as Madrid stay perfect in UCL
